subject.title: DuckDuckGo (requiresCredential=false) is never auto-selected as web_search provider even when enabled

question: Should OpenClaw reverse the shipped explicit opt-in policy and allow managed web_search to implicitly select key-free providers such as DuckDuckGo when no credentialed provider is configured?
rationale: Current main, docs, tests, and the merged policy PR require explicit selection for key-free managed web_search providers, so changing this is a provider-routing and outbound-data policy choice rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in
options.body: Maintain the current provider-selection default and use diagnostics or setup guidance to tell users how to select DuckDuckGo explicitly.

options.title: Approve full keyless fallback
options.body: Allow implicit keyless fallback only with matching runtime metadata, docs, setup behavior, tests, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause the candidate PR
options.body: Leave the implementation PR unmerged until the policy owner sponsors a narrower direction.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Maintain the current provider-selection default and use diagnostics or setup guidance to tell users how to select DuckDuckGo explicitly.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged explicit opt-in policy that this issue asks maintainers to revisit.
